label: Process
title: From the business task to a working system.
lead: A clear sequence: understand the problem, plan the solution, build it, then launch with agreed support.

steps.title: Discovery
steps.description: We clarify the problem, requirements, constraints and expected result before technical decisions are made.

steps.title: Planning & Design
steps.description: We define structure, usage scenarios and a technical approach for the agreed scope of the project.

steps.title: Engineering
steps.description: We build the product and check that it matches the agreed requirements before release.

steps.title: Launch & Support
steps.description: We prepare the product for launch and agree further support separately for the project.
